title: Epics forced to merge clusters that bridge domains should document internal implementation phasing
description: Epic 5 has 9 features (exceeding the 3-8 target) because EM-7 bridges clusters F (backend scoping) and H (full-stack employee UI), forcing a merge. The epic spans two architectural layers: backend-only scoping logic and full-stack employee management.
root_cause: Phase 1.2 (Form Epic Candidates) correctly preserves cluster atomicity by merging clusters F and H due to EM-7's dual membership. However, it does not document or recommend internal implementation phasing when the resulting epic spans multiple architectural layers. The downstream plan_phase_epic needs this guidance.
recommendation: In Phase 1.2, when a cluster merge produces an epic exceeding 8 features, add a note in the epic's description recommending internal implementation phasing: 'This epic merges clusters X and Y due to feature Z bridging both. Recommended internal execution order: (1) backend-only features first (cluster X), (2) full-stack features second (cluster Y).' This guidance should be included in the epic_dag.json epic description and the GitHub issue body.
initiative_context: Janus Communication Surveillance Platform, Phase 1, 35 features, 5 epics
